notes.title: 0921 Small updates + bug patches
notes.content:
1. A bug that can't click seeds even after watering them in the cafe has been fixed  

2. Simplified/traditional Chinese translation has been updated. (This was the request of the translator.) 

3. Polish translation has been added. 

4. I chose to cut my tongue, but I solved a bug where the saved Mabel character appeared at the same time and I couldn't proceed with the tongue cutting option 

5.The storage has been reduced from 3.6GB to 2.0GB by organizing unnecessary files for the game



Bug reports are always welcome.

Bug report: 

Discord: dead_meat793

Email: panhwa1004@naver.com





+I'm currently fixing a bug that can't press exit right in the first prologue. 

+Translation support is always welcome.

notes.title: 0915 Patch: Update for 16:10 resolution users!
notes.content: [p]I've corrected the overlapping of the item window and the arrow to the right. Now that I've pulled the arrow a little more inside the screen, it won't overlap anymore. It can now proceed normally.[/p][p][/p][p]16:9 resolution users may find it a little awkward to have arrows gathered in the middle, but please still play it as it is. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8474bb4fc47f40b0d36eeface4ed69e17d9da3fa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I[b]f the update doesn't apply, please log out the steam and log in and update it.[/b] [/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Found a Bug? Let Us Know!
notes.content: [p]Thank you very much for the warm support and interest you have shown, even though the game has just been released.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/feb7f56217e564ee5a28bc6916adc6dee2d2979f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3] [b]If you encounter any issues during gameplay, such as bugs or clogged spots, please don't hesitate to contact me![/b]  [/h3][p][/p][p] You can contact us via our official Discord DM or email. [/p][p]The reported bugs will be dealt with as soon as possible.    [/p][p]Discord is easier for me, but if you don't have an account, please let me know via email.  [/p][p]DM on sns is fine, but sometimes my account gets stuck, so please contact me via discord or email as much as possible!     [/p][p][/p][p][b]Discord: dead_meat793  [/b][/p][p][b]Email: panhwa1004@naver.com[/b]    [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for your feedback, and we look forward to your continued cooperation.[/p]

notes.title: purgatory's flower Demo is on the June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [h3][b]Demo of purgatory's flower is out ![/b] [/h3][h3]and[/h3][h3] we are participating in the [b]June Steam Next Fest[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8974f9513ccb118a6b09994f3323b64bec334cd2.png"][/img][/p][h3]If you have time, please listen to the characters' stories for a moment.[/h3][h3]Purgatory flowers will be released in September.[/h3][p]This game deals with the miserable, tragic, and beautiful memories of two women, and the pain and healing that have occurred from them. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_Yws7WmKNG0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The amount of the demo is 1/5 of the total, and the playtime is about 30 minutes. [/p][p]several endings are waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][p]Demo game only supports English and Korean, but in the main game, English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, and Turkish are waiting. [/p][p]Also, translation volunteering is always welcome![/p][p](The countries above already have translators.)[/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy the stories of prisoners struggling to escape from purgatory![/p]
